messages.subject: Re: tidyLPA
parts:
Davide, I'm sorry for the delay, thank you for your message.

You can't increase the iterations right now in tidyLPA, though you can in the development version here: https://github.com/cjvanlissa/tidyLPA

We can help with this

See details here: https://rdrr.io/cran/mclust/man/emControl.html

On Thu, Nov 29, 2018 at 7:10 AM Davide Morselli <davide....@unil.ch> wrote:

Hello

I have just discovered the tidyLPA package and I am a bit puzzled by the fact that I get different model estimates (BIC, entropy, loglik) when I rerun the analysis several times (with quite a sensible variation!). see output below.

I think it might be a problem of local maxima, but I couldn't find a way to increase the number of iteration to pass to mclust. any suggestion? The problem is fixed if I set seeds to a fixed number

Thanks


Davide
